guides.title: Tribeca
guides.dek: Thirty-seven in Tribeca, from Frenchette and The Odeon to Locanda Verde, Jungsik, Atera and Au Cheval, plus Zucker's Bagels and Los Tacos No. 1 for something quicker.

guides.title: West Village
guides.dek: The West Village's Italian run, Via Carota, Don Angie, L'Artusi, Dante and Palma, plus Semma for South Indian, Decoy for Peking duck, and 4 Charles Prime Rib.

guides.title: SoHo
guides.dek: SoHo from Balthazar and Raoul's to Le Coucou, pizza at Rubirosa and Lucia, Fanelli Cafe, and pastry at Dominique Ansel Bakery.

guides.title: Midtown East
guides.dek: Midtown East's grand rooms: The Modern, Le Pavillon, THE GRILL and The Polo Bar, steak at Smith & Wollensky and Sparks, and drinks at the King Cole Bar.

guides.title: Lower East Side
guides.dek: The Lower East Side: Katz's Delicatessen, Russ & Daughters, Una Pizza Napoletana, Dirt Candy, Sixty Three Clinton, and il laboratorio del gelato.

guides.title: Italian
guides.dek: Twenty-seven for Italian, from Carbone and Torrisi to Marea, Via Carota and Don Angie, plus Lilia in Brooklyn and Campagnola on the Upper East Side.

guides.title: French
guides.dek: French across Manhattan: Le Bernardin, Daniel, Jean-Georges and Per Se, bistros like Raoul's and Pastis, and brasseries Frenchette and The Odeon.

guides.title: New American
guides.dek: Twenty-two New American rooms, from Per Se and Daniel to Atera, Blue Hill in Greenwich Village, Manhatta in the Financial District, and Vinegar Hill House.

guides.title: Steak
guides.dek: Thirteen steakhouses: Keens in Koreatown, Delmonico's in the Financial District, COTE in the Flatiron, Sparks, Smith & Wollensky, and Wolfgang's in Tribeca.

guides.title: Bakery
guides.dek: Eleven bakeries, from Levain and Dominique Ansel to Peter Pan Donut & Pastry Shop in Greenpoint, Rio De La Plata in Elmhurst, and Ceres in Little Italy.
